line.comment: * Preliminary checks.
* Add-Ons 1.4.24a: Don't do anything if the ship is an unarmed abandoned ship. Don't want any ghost ships fleeing!
* Let's make sure this signal is not spammed.
* Mordan3 - avoid doing anything if running. (Removed in Add-Ons 1.4.10 to give the player one final chance to catch the Renegade)
* do if [THIS]-> get local variable: name='mayhem_RenegadeShipFleeing'
* return null
* Expanded 2.2: Explorers got to flee.
* Zero Hour 2.0
* Phanon ignores player attacks unless he joined the OCV
* Terraformers ignore player attacks if he joins them
* Make sure both are enemies.
* Doesn't seem to work when $attacker is [PLAYERSHIP]. See !fight.attack.object -> CheckFriendlyFire: routine.
* Player carriers. If they have idle ships onboard, we make them support ships. Same code in !fight.attack.object.
* Check if we have an escort squadron and order the leader to attack (followers "attack same" so we don't need to manage them here).
* Consider attacking back only if we have lasers. Otherwise we flee to the nearest friendly station.
* Check if we have enough missiles.
* Ignore current target if it's in another sector.
* Huge ships don't waste their time on small ships if they already have a target, except if OOS.
* Fighters shouldn't try to hit huge ships if they haven't receive a direct order to do it, except if they're doing nothing.
* Zero Hour: do not shoot back if we have a truce!
* Counterattack if we are attacking a station.
* Always attack the attacker if we're targetting a freighter, except if it's another freighter.
* We shouldn't change target if it's not worth it.
* If we are small, prioritize other small targets.
* No combat ability.
* Zero Hour
* if we have no main batteries and just turrets we can keep moving around during in-sector combat (also see !fight.defend.sector)
* if not $attacker -> is of class [Fighter]
* $posArray = [NULL]-> call script 'Joubarbe.Lib.GetValidPos' : sector=[SECTOR] minDistance=2000 posArray=null verticalOnly=[FALSE] refobj=$attacker
* [THIS]-> interrupt task 0 with script '!move.movetopositionArray' and priority 99999: arg1=$posArray arg2=null arg3=null arg4=null
* end
* Add-Ons 2.0: If this is the dropship, fight for 180 seconds. After that, return.
* [THIS]-> interrupt task 0 with script '!fight.attack.object' and priority 527: arg1=$attacker arg2=[FALSE] arg3=[FALSE] arg4=null
* Records the attack sector as well as moving, because the interrupt buys only the ship distance:
* when it finishes, the suspended explorer task resumes exactly where it was.
* Mayhem.Task.Worker.Explorer reads mayhem_explorerFlee at its next decision point,
* avoids the sector where the attack occurred, and clears the variable.
